reading_note: The teaching describes the descent-arc: how the love of self (Darkness) collided with divine truth (Light), how through their commingling the natural world came into being as a vessel where particles of celestial good lie buried within self-loves to be refined out, how out of this mixed condition the natural mind (Adam) was molded, and how — eating from the tree of sensory knowledge — its outer eyes were opened to natural sight while spiritual vision was lost. The arc: collision → mingling → world-formation → indwelling-for-refinement → molding of the natural man → opening of merely external sight.
